evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/rentals.tsx — every data-fetching route wrapper destructures only `{ data, isLoading }` from useQuery and never reads `isError`/`error`: RentalsDashboardPageRoute (lines 233-248, two queries: reservations + connections), PlatformConnectionsPageRoute (293-300), BookingsPageRoute (352-354), BookingDetailPageRoute (query feeding line 434), GuestRegistrationPageRoute (484-487). The sibling useMutation calls in the same file DO handle failure (`onError: (error) => handleRentalsAuthError(error, logout)` at lines 311/323/417/427), so query and mutation error handling diverge.

There is no mitigating global or boundary-level handler: main.tsx:28-35 constructs `new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime, retry: 1 } } })` with no `queryCache` onError and no `throwOnError`, and TanStack Query v5 does NOT surface resolved-but-errored queries to an ErrorBoundary by default. The top-level <ErrorBoundary> in main.tsx:50 only catches render-time throws, not these async query rejections. No `errorElement`/ErrorBoundary wraps the rentals routes (grep of routes/ for ErrorBoundary|errorElement returns nothing).

Impact 1 (misleading data): on a failed reservations/connections fetch, RentalsDashboardPageRoute renders a dashboard computed from `data?.data?.data ?? []` (line 250) — statistics show 0 bookings / 0 revenue / currency defaulted to 'EUR' (lines 256-265) as if the account genuinely has no rentals, instead of an error surface.

Impact 2 (infinite spinner): BookingDetailPageRoute guards with `if (isLoading || !data || !data.data)` (line 434) and returns a spinner. After a query error `isLoading` is false but `data` is undefined, so the `!data` branch keeps the page on a perpetual loading spinner with no error/retry affordance.

Impact 3 (auth divergence): a 401 on any of these queries is swallowed — unlike the mutations, the queries never call `handleRentalsAuthError(error, logout)`, so an expired/revoked session on the rentals dashboard neither surfaces an error nor triggers logout/redirect; the user just sees an empty or perpetually-loading page.

Confidence MEDIUM (static-only): the missing isError handling, the empty-default computation, and the `isLoading || !data` spinner guard are confirmed by direct read; the QueryClient defaults and absence of a route-level ErrorBoundary are confirmed from main.tsx and a grep of routes/. Not upgraded to HIGH because the exact runtime render of each page component (under frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/.../pages, outside this segment) was not re-read this run.

Fix (cloud-landable, frontend-only): destructure `isError`/`error` from each useQuery and render an error state (the app already has parseApiError in lib/errorHandler.ts and shared error surfaces), and route query failures through the same `handleRentalsAuthError(error, logout)` path the mutations use so 401s log out consistently. Single-file ppt-web edit; verifies with pnpm --filter @ppt/web typecheck + test + biome check.
